value.evidence: Both repositories expose the identical 62-path source-skill manifest. Private has 335 generated USR records, the old generator, no focused test and a failing unchanged validator; accepted public has 62 records, the repaired generator/test and a passing unchanged validator.
value.workerBoundary: One no-commit worker may change only the private generator, focused test, generated USR family/index and named return. Public is read-only. Deletion is limited to exact manifest-stale private USR records.
value.successorBoundary: No automatic PPRR-R2. Independent reviewer owns acceptance and private materialization; public mutation, merge, deployment, secrets and providers remain forbidden.
